Beamly - A Powerful Patreon Alternative with 0% Platform Fees

# Patreon vs Beamly

Beamly is a Patreon alternative for creators who want their membership to live on their own website, with control over content, branding, SEO, billing, the member experience, and how much of each sale they keep.

Patreon is a fast way to turn fans into supporters. Where it gets limiting is when the membership stops being a side project and starts becoming the business. At that point you usually need a real website, a full content library, multiple monetization paths, and predictable costs that do not scale up with every new subscriber.

That is the gap Beamly fills. It combines a creator website with memberships, paywalls, private feeds, digital products, courses, podcasts, videos, and posts. Everything can live on your own domain, and Beamly takes 0% platform fees from membership and product sales. Standard Stripe processing fees still apply.

The short answer is simple. Choose Patreon when fast setup, a familiar supporter account, and Patreon’s community tools matter most. Choose Beamly when the membership needs to become an owned podcast or creator business. For more options beyond this direct comparison, read the best Patreon alternatives.

 

## What's the difference between Beamly and Patreon?

Patreon is a well-known membership platform. It helps creators sell access to paid posts, perks, supporter tiers, and community-style updates. It is familiar to fans and easy to start.
